integrity: The proof is analytic, rests on precisely identified published fixed-space and lattice-homomorphism theorems, and makes no claim of independent verification or comprehensive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only positive contractive strongly continuous semigroups on complex monotonically complete Fatou Banach lattices. Dimensions collapse all infinite sizes to infinity; no assertion about generalized eigenspaces, approximate spectrum, or algebraic multiplicities. Qualitative prior sources were compared, but an older relevant semigroup monograph was not available in full text.
title: Harmonic eigenspace multiplicities for positive contraction semigroups
